clinician.trajectory_summary: A 23-year-old male presented with a 9-month history of watery diarrhea, weight loss, multiple necrotic crusted skin and penile ulcers, painful erythematous nodules on lower limbs, and oligoarthritis. Colonoscopy showed multiple shallow ulcers in sigmoid and proximal rectum. Tuberculin test and chest X-ray were negative. Skin ulcer biopsy histopathology revealed epithelioid granulomatous process with palisade granulomas and central caseous necrosis. Ziehl-Neelsen staining of the biopsy demonstrated acid-fast bacilli, consistent with Mycobacterium tuberculosis infection. PCR and culture results were not reported. Clinical course and treatment response details are not documented.
